correctness.rationale: The Shrikhande and 4x4 rook graphs have the same SRG parameters (16,6,2,2) but distinct neighborhoods. The vertex-subset k=2 higher-independence condition is induced maximum degree <=1. Exhaustive enumeration of all 65536 masks for each graph yields nonempty f-vectors (16,120,384,544,240,32) for Shrikhande and (16,120,384,528,144) for rook. The given pivot orders make respectively 639 and 543 disjoint matched face pairs. Independent recomputation of every Hasse incidence and Kahn acyclicity check leaves one critical vertex plus 57 or 105 critical dimension-three faces, no other cells. Discrete Morse thus gives integral homotopy wedges 57 S3 and 105 S3, not merely field homology. Boundary-rank checks separately corroborate. The finite universe is exhaustively examined, so finite proof is sufficient for these named graphs.
